purpose: Select one economically interpretable Campaign025 mechanism without opening a Campaign025 minute partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

selected_concept.economic_question: Does the session establish its low before its high, rather than its high before its low, indicating upward rather than downward intraday price discovery?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: A session whose global low is established earlier and global high later represents an upward sequence of price discovery that may persist from the next open through the third close. The reverse sequence represents late downward discovery.
selected_concept.fixed_temporal_question: Use the ordered 240 one-minute high/low intervals at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, excluding standalone 09:30 while collapsing the lunch clock gap to adjacent observation positions.
